description: Build-host Debian package inventory (ADR-0006). Every apt install in the OSE-003 images reads from this one immutable Debian snapshot. Packages that OSE drives directly are also pinned by version and .deb SHA-256, checked before install and re-checked by version on every use. Read by scripts/lib/debpins.py.

snapshot.evidence: the timestamp the base image itself records in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources (comment lines), observed 2026-11-27

unhashed_build_packages.note: Version fixed by the snapshot and verified by apt against the snapshot's signed index; versions actually installed are recorded in artifacts/evidence/ose-003/hercules-version.txt. Not hashed individually: they build Hercules, which is itself checked by its 293-test suite and by version and commit.

packages.name: regina-rexx
packages.role: REXX interpreter required by the Hercules test suite (make check); hercules-helper installs it too
packages.license_evidence: /usr/share/doc/libregina3/copyright: 'Library General Public License ... version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version'

packages.name: libregina3-dev
packages.role: Regina headers, so Hercules configure enables REXX support

packages.name: s3270
packages.role: Scripted 3270 client for the TSO smoke test (OSE-003 acceptance test 5)
packages.license_evidence: /usr/share/doc/s3270/copyright (DEP-5) names licenses x3270, x3270+xterm, cme, keysym2ucs, ncd, pr3270: BSD-style permissive texts not mapped to SPDX ids here. Test tool only, never shipped.

packages.name: netbase
packages.role: /etc/protocols and /etc/services; s3270 and Python socket.getprotobyname need them (upstream sysgen Docker/Dockerfile installs it too)
packages.license_evidence: /usr/share/doc/netbase/copyright (DEP-5): 'License: GPL-2' (only vs or-later not stated in that field)
